properties.name: The step for when a batch lands is cued once per batch; add_change_event names its checksum step (increment 7 of cognition plus memory)
properties.rationale:
Increment 7 of epoch:planned-cognition-plus-memory (epoch:planned-the-tool-surface-refined-from-the-counts), at Anthony's word 2026-10-30 ("Start step 7 alongside"), for req:a-cue-for-when-a-batch-lands-is-offered-once-per-batch-and-a-process-names-its-step. The counts: on 0.94.0 the six writers were offered detect_gaps 97 times and followed 0, detect-and-ask 75/0, governed_by 31/0, detect_defects and check-health 17/0, loop_status 162 times and followed within five calls twice, otherwise only at round end (fact:the-recall-pilot-after-the-cues-scored-25-full-16-kit-cued-at-12kb-3-uncued-2026-10-30); the same tools are called on flo2.io where needed (211, 397, 226, 33), and 207 of set_artifact_checksums' 327 runs came right after add_change_event with nothing in its reply naming the step (fact:the-served-tools-sorted-by-their-counts-109-used-5-cued-unfollowed-40-never-reached-6-steps-39-close-2026-10-30). So the cue's timing moved and its id did not, so increment 6 can compare; a process tool names its measured step. Kept out, recorded as proposals for the owner's word: listing step-only tools under their process tool (req:the-measured-step-only-tools-are-listed-under-their-process-tool), fold and removal candidates (dec:idea-fold-and-removal-candidates-from-the-2026-10-30-counts), what the cue count counts (dec:idea-what-the-cue-count-counts-reference-hints-out-a-carried-pointer-in), record_the_build's reach (dec:idea-the-steps-of-record-what-was-built-point-at-record-the-build). The process-globals rule caught the new task-local; it is one call's value and is accounted for in ALLOWED.
Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Six loop_hint cue ids that name the step for when a batch of writes lands (detect_gaps, get_skill:detect-and-ask, detect_defects, get_skill:check-health, loop_status, governed_by) are offered on a batch's first write and withheld on its later ones: cues::withheld reads the usage ledger's last 256 KB in call_tool, per session (seat, or the --call door as one sequence), and withholds a cue offered within the session's last 25 calls and 15 minutes with no call since acting on it; handlers read the set through a task-local (writes only; none without a ledger). A hint that is only the batch step becomes "loop: the step for when this batch lands was named earlier in the batch and is not repeated on every write" (names no call); a hint with a per-node half keeps that half. Ids and words unchanged when offered; set_decision_status's owner-only cue untouched. add_change_event's reply gains `next_step` naming set_artifact_checksums (design_updated, this change's id) when an Artifact not removed is among `affected`; record_the_build's step receipts drop it. Additive: no tool, argument or field removed or renamed; tool schemas unchanged.
